description: Placing of storage containers and staff welfare facilities on the site for a temporary period of five years, with associated works and installation of replacement entrance gates.
decision_conditions: <p><span data-sheets-root="1" style="">Prior to occupation of the development hereby approved, precise details of cycle parking shall be submitted to and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall, thereafter be carried out in strict accordance with the approved details. The area for cycle parking shall be kept clear of obstruction other than for its intended purpose.<br><br>REASON: To promote sustainable transport.</span></p>

<div style="">Prior to the occupation of the development hereby approved, details must be submitted to and approved by the Local Authority to demonstrate at least the consented standards have been met, as set out in the hereby approved Energy Strategy (Revision 02 by AJ Consultants Limited, dated February 2026):</div><div style=""><br>a) Minimum Heat pump Seasonal Energy Efficiency Ratio of 7 &nbsp;<br>b) Minimum Heat pump Seasonal Coefficient of Performance of 4.5<br>c) Details of location of the condenser units from the heat pump systems and any noise solutions to mitigate the impact for nearby sensitive receptors.</div><div style=""><br></div><div style="">REASON: In the interest of addressing climate change and securing sustainable and net zero development and construction, in accordance with LP55 of the Hackney Local Plan</div>

<p>A Construction Management Plan (CMP) specifying hours of working, construction traffic routing, measures to prevent dust pollution and contact arrangements between residents and contractors shall be submitted and agreed by the Local Planning Authority Prior to the commencement of the development. The CMP shall include the following details:&nbsp;<br><br>(a) loading and unloading of plant and materials;&nbsp;<br>(b) storage of plant and materials;&nbsp;<br>(c) programme of works (including measures for traffic management);&nbsp;<br>(d) provision of boundary hoarding behind any visibility zones;&nbsp;<br>(e) wheel cleaning provision on site. Construction shall thereafter take place in accordance with the measures identified within the CMP.&nbsp;<br><br>REASON: To ensure that during demolition and construction works that there would be no negative amenity or highway impacts as a result of the development. These details are required prior to commencement as they affect the entirety of the construction phase and cannot, therefore, be dealt with retrospectively.</p>

<p dir="ltr" style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">This permission shall expire after a period of five years from the date of this decision.</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; vertical-align: baseline;"><br></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON: In order that the Local Planning Authority can review any change in circumstances after this period and to avoid the accumulation of unimplemented permissions.</span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-f45090da-7fff-e31a-3f0d-e9d0a98a7352"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">The operational hours for the site shall be Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. – 7 p.m.; Saturdays, 9 a.m. – 7 p.m.; and Sundays and Bank Holidays, 10 a.m. – 5 p.m.. The operating hours for th hours and will be controlled via a time restricting fob entry system. </span></span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-f45090da-7fff-e31a-3f0d-e9d0a98a7352"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON: Reduce negative impact on residential amenities by way of noise.</span></span></p>

The noise level from all plant and machinery included in the approved development shall at all times remain 5dB(A) below background levels when measured at any nearby residential window or other sensitive receptor if appropriate (add/delete as appropriate)


REASON: To ensure that occupiers of neighbouring premises do not suffer a loss of amenity by reason of noise nuisance and other excess noise.

The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<div style="">Prior to the occupation of the development hereby approved, details and full specifications of 3 swift bricks/boxes shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include a minimum of 3 swift bricks (same requirements for swift box) incorporated into the design of the development. They should be installed in groups of at least 2, and placed at or close to eaves level of the development hereby approved. They should be placed at least 5m above the ground with a 5m unobstructed flight path, both below and in front of the swift brick. The swift brick should be located facing north, east, or north east (direct sunlight should be avoided) and should not be placed immediately above doors or windows. Where possible, swift bricks should be set flush into the external wall to match adjacent brickwork.</div><div style=""><br></div><div style="">Within a month of the first occupation of the development, evidence must be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority that swift bricks/boxes have been installed in line with the approved details unless otherwise agreed in writing.&nbsp;&nbsp;The details hereby approved shall be delivered, in full, prior to the first occupation of the development and shall be maintained for the lifespan of the development.&nbsp;</div><div style=""><br></div><div style="">REASON:&nbsp;To support swift populations in Hackney and preserve endangered urban biodiversity, by providing nesting opportunities, in accordance with Hackney’s Local Plan LP33 policy LP47 which states that all development schemes involving buildings with an eaves height or roof commencement height of 5 metres and above are required to provide nesting boxes for swifts, sparrows, starlings, and/or bats as appropriate.</div>
